title: eLab's ongoing projects
description: I collaboratori e le collaboratrici dell'eLab sono attualmente impegnati nei seguenti progetti o mandati:

blocks.html: eLab staff are currently working on the following projects or mandates:

items.title: EASE - Educational Academic Staff Empowerment
items.html:
Objective: empower teaching skills of USI instructors through an effective integration of digital tools
Info: project description on USI website
Duration: January 2025 - December 2026
Type: Project funded by swissuniversities within the PgB "Open Education & Digital Competencies"

items.title: Costruire spazi di dialogo per la risoluzione dei conflitti
items.html:
Objective: design and facilitation of LSP workshops within a toolkit for conflict management through dialogue and argumentation
Info: project website (in Italian)
Duration: September 2024 - August 2026
Type: Agora FNS Project

items.title: Support for the online Master in Interreligious Dialogue of the Faculty of Theology of Lugano
items.html:
Objective: Technical and pedagogical support for the online Master of Arts in "Interreligious Dialogue" of Istituto ReTe (Faculty of Theology of Lugano)
Info: Web page of the Master on the website of Istituto ReTe
Duration: From March 2021
Type: Mandate of the Faculty of Theology of Lugano - Istituto ReTe

items.title: Support to the online Master in "Philosophy, Theology and Religions" of the University of Lucerne
items.html:
Objective: Technical and pedagogical support to the online Master in "Philosophy, Theology and Religions" of the University of Lucerne
Duration: From July 2021
Type: Mandate of the University of Lucerne, Theological Faculty Lucerne
